lines.text: Many learners say: I am work in a bank.
Better: I work in a bank.
Do not put am before work.
Work! We work in a bank.

data.wrong: I am work in a bank.
data.why: Do not put am before work.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «أنا موظف في بنك» بلا فعل، فنضيف am خطأً، لكن work فعل يكفي وحده: “I work in a bank.” وليس “I am work in a bank”

en.hook: Do you say “I am work in a bank”?
en.tip: Work is a verb by itself: “I work in a bank.” not “I am work in a bank”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I am work in a bank.” 😅 In English work is a verb by itself, so we do not add am, so the right sentence is “I work in a bank.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
